purpose: Single source of truth for partner cover logos across deck-studio decks. Reconciles the stale queue 'needs_sourcing' list against reality. A deck cover logo bind is GATED on status=='banked' with a non-null source_url + Drive file. Territory/Navier-only decks are intentional_null and must never receive a guessed badge.

navier_logo.sourcing_rule: Shared Navier wordmark/mark, slide-1 top-left. Source canonical Navier brand asset + publish to Drive once; reuse across every deck.

bind_gate: Cover logo may only be applied when status=='banked' AND source_url!=null AND drive_file_id!=null. Otherwise leave the cover logo object untouched (do not substitute, do not guess).
